name: aa-passport-runner
//: The AA console/deploy runner's dependency tree, installed ONCE at /aa so that it
serves three importers at the same time: the runner's own TypeScript, the Passport
fork's client library (copied to /aa/passport/src, run directly by bun), and the
compactc-generated contract modules at /aa/passport/contracts/managed/*/contract/
index.js, which resolve @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime by walking UP the tree.
⚠ PROJECT 00034 REPLACED THE WHOLE LIST. It used to be built around
@effectstream/midnight-contracts, whose helpers wrapped the wallet and providers for
the AA-v3 Manager. The Passport fork ships its own node layer (src/node/wallet.ts:
WalletFacade, providers, a zk-config REGISTRY over the artifact root — a registry,
not a single bundle, because proving a cross-contract call tree needs the keys of
EVERY contract in the tree), so the effectstream wrappers are gone and there is ONE
source of network plumbing again.
EVERY PIN THAT CROSSES A WIRE IS THE FORK'S. The fork's contract/package.json is the
authority for midnight-js (5.0.0-beta.7), compact-js (2.5.5-rc.8), compact-runtime
(0.19.0), ledger-v9 (1.0.0-rc.3) and the wallet SDK, because the artifacts this image
compiles were generated by the compiler those pins name. The image ASSERTS the
agreement rather than trusting this comment: the compact stage compares compactc's
--runtime-version against BOTH the fork's and mint-test-tokens' manifests, and the
runtime stage compares it against what bun install actually resolved, requiring
exactly one copy.
What must additionally agree with the KERNEL pin (effectstream/zswap-offerfiles-kernel
@ 5d794f9a27f6d65529bf176650405f740531d430) is what crosses the wire to it:
@midnightntwrk/ledger-v9 1.0.0-rc.3 (the offer blob's ledger types) and
@effectstream/mip-zswap-offer 0.4.0-v9.0 (the MIP-0005 encoding the kernel parses).
Those two are unchanged by this migration: the offer artefact's SHAPE is the same
proven, unbalanced, DUST-free transaction it always was — only the circuit that
produces it changed (Manager `execute` selector 6 -> account
`open_swap_shielded_with_evm`), which is why the kernel and the solver need no change.
//overrides: ledger-v9 collapses to ONE wasm copy: two copies in one process carry different
per-instance class identity and every cross-copy value fails an instanceof check.
compact-runtime is pinned for the adjacent reason, and it is NECESSARY with compactc
0.34.0 (infra 00015): several packages in this tree declare an EXACT 0.18.0-rc.1, so
without the override bun installs the hoisted 0.19.0 plus nested older copies — which
is what the image's one-copy assertion catches. The Passport fork makes exactly this
override in its own vault package for the same reason.
